name: Henan Liliang Diamond Co., Ltd.
summary: Henan Liliang Diamond Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of artificial diamond products in China. The company offers lab grown diamonds, single crystal diamonds, diamond micro powder, and ornaments used in precision manufacturing, geological drilling, aerospace and military industry, photovoltaic new energy, third-generation semiconductors, jewelry, and other related fields. Henan Liliang Diamond Co., Ltd. was founded in 2010 and is based in Shangqiu, China.
